DesignationCategoryDef.label: back room
DesignationCategoryDef.description: Doors, pits, counters and docks for the things nobody talks about. Only shown once you have discovered the underworld.

ResearchProjectDef.label: a back room (key)
ResearchProjectDef.description: Internal key project. Finished when the stranger's offer is accepted. Never shown.

ResearchProjectDef.label: the back room
ResearchProjectDef.description: Back room doors, the fight pit, the fence's counter, the smuggler's dock and the drug lounge: everything a house needs for the trade that is not on the menu.

ResearchProjectDef.label: the hunt
ResearchProjectDef.description: A fenced hunting ground. Rich visitors pay well to shoot what you release into it. From Dark content on, a prisoner can be the quarry, behind a clear warning.

ResearchProjectDef.label: black clinic
ResearchProjectDef.description: A counter where anonymous donors buy harvested organs, no questions asked. Only with Dark or Grim content.
